_basis: Fabric API's tag removal returns natively at 26.1.2, not 26.2: fabric-tag-api-v1 2.1.1+371cf5db4c (26.1.2) ships FabricTagFile (default remove()), TagFileHooks (fabric_setRemove(List<TagEntry>)), TagRemovalInternals, TagFileMixin and TagLoaderMixin, member-for-member what 26.2's 2.1.4 ships (javap -p of both: identical); 26.1 / 26.1.1's 2.0.9 has none. fabric-data-generation-api-v1 24.3.4 (26.1.2) has TagBuilderHooks (fabric_getRemove / fabric_removeElement / fabric_removeTag, besides replace / forceAddTag), implemented on TagBuilder by its always-applied TagBuilderMixin, and TagsProviderMixin.addRemove sets every TagFile's removals from the builder's hooks right after it is made. The 26.1 layer's copies retire here (the 26.1.2 -> 26.2 retirement in sclimb.json came one step late: on a 26.1.2 server Fabric API's TagFileMixin could not overwrite the copy's remove(), 1565 apply failures, and on 26.2 the copy's still-active codec redirect CbFapiTagFileReadsMixin reached the retired CbFapiTagRemovals: NoClassDefFoundError in TagFile.<clinit>, no boot). Datagen follows too: the copy's builder hooks are renamed onto Fabric API's, so CbFapiTagDatagen's 1.21.11 FabricTagAppender.remove / removeAll / removeTag bodies record on the native builder store that TagsProviderMixin writes out (left on the copy's own store, the native addRemove overwrote the copy's removals with the empty native list).

retiredClasses.top/dext/centurybridge/step/v26_1/mixin/: native returns: 26.1.2's TagFileMixin makes TagFile a FabricTagFile and TagFileHooks and keeps the list; both merging remove() into TagFile is the overwrite failure

native returns: its codec redirect adds "fabric:remove" that 26.1.2's TagFileMixin adds itself (wrapping the same RecordCodecBuilder.create in <clinit>), and its constructor inject hands datagen removals that 26.1.2's TagsProviderMixin.addRemove sets from the builder's hooks right after

native returns: TagEntry id / tag, read by the retired CbFapiTagRemovals only; 26.1.2's TagEntryAccessor reads them for the native removal
native returns: it marked the builder whose TagFile was being made, for the retired CbFapiTagFileReadsMixin's constructor inject only; 26.1.2's TagsProviderMixin hands the builder's removals itself
